overture-food-places.representation: Site resources; source categories do not assert actor, ownership, retailer, producer, supplier, availability or inventory facts.

wikidata-food-businesses.representation: Organization resources; direct P31 business roles remain source fields and are not promoted to verified ownership, outlet, market coverage or stock facts.

packetization.guard: Each packet is compressed before writing. A packet larger than the limit fails before write; otherwise files rotate before a write would exceed the limit. Concatenated deterministic gzip members remain valid JSONL gzip streams.
packetization.licenceArtifacts: Overture notice texts are copied as manifest-listed licenses/overture-food-places assets.

benchmark.interpretation: A bounded performance and delivery-shape observation only; it is not source-complete, qualified or publishable.

fullRun.acceptanceGate: Only an atomic rename after all source counts, packets, schema validations, public scope checks, notice checks and manifest checks complete can change this to qualified.

diskBudget.rule: Do not publish, assemble or globally qualify the partial directory.
